thread:
nina: quick post-all-hands note on the API/Console/Optimize timeline questions. dropping key clarifications.

harry: can we confirm which features are hitting beta vs canary this quarter?

nina: Beta (Console UI hints + template import) targeted early Q3. Canary (Optimize backend + one-click apply in console) mid-Q3 for hosted. GA windows late Q3 for hosted; Dedicated/private follow Q3->Q4.

cecilia: owners to tag for comms?

marc: owners: lina (Console UX), michael (Optimize eng), raj (docs/comms).

harry: compatibility note for customers? any model/quant caveats to call out?

nina: initial support: decoder-only transformer models FP16/INT8. 4-bit quant is experimental and marked as such in UI. suggestions default to preview; no auto-changes without consent.

ops-bot: canary checklist link: https://internal.redwood/canary-checklist (ensure perf probes + eval sets enabled)

cecilia: rollback criteria?

michael: rollback triggers: p95 latency increase >20% sustained 10m OR quality regression on evals for 2 consecutive runs. cost increase alone needs to be >40% to auto-rollback.

nina: action items:
- lina: mock screenshots + beta note by Tue
- michael: canary gating doc by Thu
- raj: customer blurb + API snippet by Fri

marc: sample API snippet for docs: `POST /v1/projects/{proj}/routes/{route}/suggestions/apply` body: `{ "suggestion_id":"sugg-2830", "mode":"preview" }`

nina: thanks all, i'll update the roadmap sheet after deliverables are posted. closing unless there are blockers. :thumbsup:
